variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: The leader of {party} is being challenged. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question
variants.body: A challenge to the leadership of {party} has opened. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: A challenge inside the party
variants.body: Leadership of the party {party} is under challenge. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
